complex_event_id.description: Reference to the complex event this ticket class belongs to

early_bird_enabled.description: Whether early bird pricing is enabled

early_bird_price.description: Early bird price (lower than standard price)

early_bird_deadline.description: Deadline after which early bird pricing no longer applies

is_group_ticket.description: Whether this is a group ticket

group_size.description: Maximum number of participants in the group

group_cutoff_date.description: Deadline for modifying the group roster

vat_rate_key.description: Xero TaxType identifier for VAT calculation

vat_rate_label.description: Display name of the VAT rate

visibility_mode.description: Who can see this ticket class

role_ids.description: Role UUIDs that can purchase this ticket. Empty array means all roles.

role_match_only.description: When true and roles are set, ticket is hidden from non-matching users

offer_type.description: Type of special offer applied to this ticket

available_count.description: Number of tickets available. Null when unlimited.

is_unlimited_tickets.description: Whether this ticket has unlimited capacity

linked_track_ids.description: Array of complex_event_track UUIDs this ticket grants access to

all_tracks.description: When true, grants access to all tracks regardless of linked_track_ids

display_order.description: Display order for sorting ticket classes
